verses.original: לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū nə·ran·nə·nāh Yah·weh nā·rî·‘āh lə·ṣūr yiš·‘ê·nū
verses.literal: Come let us sing for joy to the LORD let us shout to the Rock of our salvation

verses.original: נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ׃ בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת
verses.transliteration: nə·qad·də·māh p̄ā·nāw bə·ṯō·w·ḏāh nā·rî·a‘ lōw biz·mi·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving let us make a joyful noise to Him in song

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֑ה גָּד֣וֹל אֵ֣ל גָּ֝ד֗וֹל וּמֶ֥לֶךְ עַל־ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh gā·ḏō·wl ’êl gā·ḏō·wl ū·me·leḵ ‘al- kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: For the LORD is a great God a great King above all gods

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ הָרִ֣ים וְתוֹעֲפ֖וֹת לֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: In His hand are the depths of the earth and the mountain peaks belong to Him

verses.original: הַ֭יָּם אֲשֶׁר־ ל֣וֹ וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ׃ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת
verses.transliteration: hay·yām ’ă·šer- lōw wə·hū ‘ā·śā·hū yā·ḏāw yā·ṣā·rū wə·yab·be·šeṯ
verses.literal: The sea is His for He made it and His hands formed the dry land

verses.original: בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְנִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽפְנֵי־ יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bō·’ū niš·ta·ḥă·weh wə·niḵ·rā·‘āh niḇ·rə·ḵāh lip̄·nê- Yah·weh ‘ō·śê·nū
verses.literal: O come let us worship and bow down let us kneel before the LORD our Maker

verses.original: כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם־ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃ בְּקֹל֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: kî hū ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wa·’ă·naḥ·nū ‘am mar·‘î·ṯōw wə·ṣōn yā·ḏōw hay·yō·wm ’im- ṯiš·mā·‘ū bə·qō·lōw
verses.literal: For He is our God and we are the people of His pasture the sheep under His care Today if you hear His voice

verses.original: אַל־ תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָ֑ה כְּי֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- taq·šū lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem kim·rî·ḇāh kə·yō·wm mas·sāh bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah in the day at Massah in the wilderness

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם נִ֭סּוּנִי בְּ֝חָנ֗וּנִי גַּם־ רָא֥וּ פָעֳלִֽי׃
verses.literal: where your fathers tested and tried Me though they had seen My work

verses.original: אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה׀ אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר הֵ֑ם עַ֤ם לֵבָ֣ב תֹּעֵ֣י וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא־ יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh ’ā·qūṭ bə·ḏō·wr wā·’ō·mar hêm ‘am lê·ḇāḇ tō·‘ê wə·hêm lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū ḏə·rā·ḵāy
verses.literal: For forty years I was angry with that generation and I said They are a people whose hearts go astray and they have not known My ways

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי בְאַפִּ֑י אִם־ יְ֝בֹא֗וּן אֶל־ מְנוּחָתִֽי׃
verses.literal: So I swore on oath in My anger They shall never enter . . . My rest
